title: Kacie's mom:
headline: The director's mother tells the one thing nobody else on the day can: Kacie's dad dreamed the Dream Center, she grew up seeing it, and he was proud of what it became.
story: Kacie Kintz runs the Dream Center Dallas. On the 10 Oct Adopt-A-Block, Kalindi filmed Kacie's mom indoors for about a minute. Her story is a family one: her dad had a dream for this and she grew up seeing it. He passed away a year and a half ago and was proud of the Dream Center. Then the heart of it, in her words: take care of people who need food, and love.

Series: Why We're Here. Hopeful, never somber. The loss is one line, said plainly, and the cut moves straight to pride and to the people being cared for. One voice, hers. Kalindi's questions are not in the cut.
do: Open on her face, already talking, with the hook text on screen at 0:00.
Keep it one voice. Only Kacie's mom speaks. Kalindi's questions are cut out.
Cut the smiles and the car line under the “take care of people” line, then come back to her face.
End on her laugh (Interview 5 at 0:02) after the last line. Hold 1 s.
dont: No logo, no name, no fade at 0:00.
Do NOT make the loss the point. One line, then forward. The client wants moving, not sad.
Do NOT use Kalindi's voice or her “Oh, this is mom” line.
No trash, empty boxes or clutter in any B-roll shot.
No full names for neighbors. First names only, and only if they say it on camera.
Do NOT use the numbers (500, 2,500, 1,400). They belong to Kacie's own cut, DreamCenterDallasKacieNeedIsMassive001.
